text:
jen (marketing): hey team, last-minute ask for the Tues webinar demo. can runtime run a focused bench rerun and hand off artifacts we can cite? requirements below.

omar: sure—outline please. what cohorts, quant, and what level of traces?

jen (marketing): cohorts: 1) hotpath short-context (70% of requests), 2) long-context tail (30%, up to 8k tokens). quant: int8. need per-request p50/p95/p99, cold vs warm breakdown, and raw trace snippets for 50 long-context requests. also checksummed requests file and exact command + docker/kernel tag.

rachel: operational constraints: prefer runs on `stable-2026-01` kernel, enable qkv-fuse, set batch_profile=conservative, seed=2026. warmup policy: replay 10% of hotpath once and run 5 warmup requests per worker. target p99 hotpath <=600ms else we want a short root-cause note.

jen (marketing): perfect. deadline: deliver artifacts by Fri EOD PT. include a 2-sentence methods blurb and an anonymized long-context example we can paste in the slides. 

omar: noted. reserving Fri 15:00-16:30 PT slot. runtime-bot will publish job links. we'll capture KV-cache hit ratio, kernel selection per batch, and per-request timing.

eng-runtime-bot: Scheduled job id rjob-20260326-199. window Fri 15:00-16:20 PT. logs -> https://internal/runs/rjob-20260326-199. ETA artifact upload 30m after completion.

omar: quick reproducibility snippet to include in docs:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/bench 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"model":"llama-13b-int8","requests_file":"/tmp/requests_longtail.json","seed":2026,"batch_profile":"conservative"}'
```

please publish `sha256(/tmp/requests_longtail.json)=` and the docker image tag.

tom: posting a dev smoke we saw earlier so marketing knows variance causes:

```
[2026-02-25T12:04:10Z] worker-3 p99=782ms req_id=xyz789 tokens=5120
 trace: fallback-path -> host-kernel -> recompile-quant
 note: observed when warmup omitted for that shard; KV hit ratio ~12%
```

tom: we'll make sure prod run follows the warmup plan to avoid that.

rachel: final checklist for deliverables: 1) checksummed requests file (sha256), 2) run command and docker/kernel tag, 3) per-slice latency table (short vs long, cold vs warm), 4) 50 anonymized long-context traces, 5) 2-sentence methods blurb, 6) quick diagnostic if p99>600ms. we'll upload to /artifacts/marketing/webinar-2026-03-26/.

jen (marketing): amazing — thank you. drop the artifacts in #marketing when ready or ping me directly. :raised_hands:
